notes.content:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384660/FPV_SkyDive__Micro_Drone_Edition/

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1278060/view/534344040319026826

[*] Gym map (day version)

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1278060/view/572625355297260730

[*] New Micro Drones: Bolt & Cloud – Speed-focused racing & agile freestyle options
[*] ORQA Whoop for All – The base micro drone, now free for every player
[/list]

With a flexible structure for unlimited future expansions, the Micro Drone Edition DLC is your ticket to the next level of micro FPV flying.

🎮 Available now – take flight and experience the future of micro drone racing & freestyle! 🚀🔥

notes.title: Update 2.7
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!

To celebrate crossing the [b]million-user milestone[/b], we’ve prepared something never seen before in 2.7 version of the simulator. Highlights are:

[h1]NEW ORQA WHOOP & FREE CONTENT[/h1]

The brand-new ORQA Whoop, soon hitting the market with a complete redesign, is now available for free in the simulator! This update gives all players the chance to experience the thrill and feel of ORQA’s latest micro drone before it even launches.

Along with it, players get 8 Whoop race tracks, a new challenge, and access to the Indoor Gym map (which were part of the DLC)—[b]all for free![/b] - and no, this isn’t an April Fools’ joke! 

Meanwhile, the NewBee Whoop is being deprecated and replaced with complete ORQA product. With Dream-X and the new ORQA Whoop, all players can now fly our drones completely free and get ready for the real thing one day! 

[b]This is something never seen before in the world of simulators! A unique chance to fly both regular and micro drones—completely free![/b]

[h2]NEW OIL RIG MAP[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/a497fb98e7974ed762a41210ad70ceae3e90af84.png[/img]

Our goal has always been to deliver as much content as possible while keeping the experience accessible for casual players. That’s why we’re making the Oil Rig map - [b]completely free![/b]

Now, you can fly all types of drones in this prop-filled environment, bringing a fresh new challenge and tons of fun. We hope you enjoy the experience and push your flying skills to the next level!

[h2]DLC REFRESH: MICRO DRONE EDITION[/h2]

Big changes are coming to the Whoop section in the Micro Drone Edition DLC! We’ve got big plans for the Whoops, which have proven to be an excellent entry point into the world of FPV.

With our commitment to providing access to the free ORQA Whoop, we’ve decided to upgrade the existing whoop oriented DLC with fresh content. 

First and foremost, we’re changing the name from NewBee x IRC Drone DLC to [b]Micro Drone Edition DLC[/b]—this shift allows us to enhance the content and provide more flexibility for future updates. Get ready for an even better experience! 

Changes and additions to the Micro Drone Edition (from 2nd of April):
[list]
[*] Two new micro drones [i][b]Bolt[/b][/i] and [i][b]Cloud[/b][/i] have been added, each offering a unique flying experience.
[*] 4 new night-themed tracks for a fresh challenge and immersive experience.
[*] Japan Pack extension brings the distinct atmosphere of Japan and its culture, perfectly optimized for Whoops.
[*] Parking garage remains part of the DLC[/list]
An exciting new feature: each of the new additions can now be purchased individually as items, instead of having to buy the entire DLC. However, keep in mind that purchasing the DLC provides a financial benefit, offering better value than buying each item separately.

As we’re adding even more exciting content, the price of the DLC will increase from $5.99 to $9.99 USD. But don’t worry—this small price bump brings you a huge amount of extra value with all the new features and content! It’s still a great deal for everything you’re getting.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384660/FPV_SkyDive__Micro_Drone_Edition/

[h2]JAPAN PACK 🇯🇵[/h2]

For the first time, we’re aiming to create something truly spectacular with the most attractive item in the Whoop lineup. In collaboration with WTW (Wednesday Tokyo Whoopers) organisation, one of the most active communities of Japanese FPV drone pilots we’ve created a unique Japan-inspired environment tailored for micro drones.

We’ve prepared for you the [b]Japan Garden map and 4 custom tracks[/b] featuring unseen gate designs to bring a fresh and exciting experience.

Get the Micro Drone Edition DLC or the Japan Pack separately today and don’t miss the chance to try something extraordinary—something that will keep you glued to your favorite controller and simulator!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1278060/view/572625355297260730

[b]Detailed 2.7 update changelog:[/b]
[list]  
[*] Performance boost up to x2*
[*] Optimized UI logic for better game performance and reduced system load  
[*] 8 racing tracks, Day Gym, and ORQA Whoop now free for all players  
[*] User settings no longer stored in local files  
[*] NewBee x IRC Whoop DLC renamed and redesigned as Micro Drone Edition DLC  
[*] Added Japan Pack with 4 racetracks and a Garden map  
[*] New content added to Micro Drone Edition DLC, with standalone item purchases now available  
[*] Two new micro drones added: Cloud and Bolt  
[*] New Oil Rig map added—free for all drone types (regular and micro)
[*] Updated Error debugger which will show blinking red square in top left corner of the screen in case of critical error. 

[b]In case you are experiencing red blinking square in the top left corner of the screen, make sure to rapidly click on the square and open Console list and send us bug report in [url=https://discord.gg/g5dvZS6neu]Discord[/url] with a screenshot of console with visible error title and message.[/b]
[/list]  
[i]*Based on benchmark testing of each map and their draw call, tris count, vert count, cpu main time and FPS data (average FPS improvement is 70%)[/i]

As we approach another milestone—5,000 members on Discord—we’ve got some exciting activations lined up that you’re sure to love! Join our community today: https://discord.gg/g5dvZS6neu

🛒 Purchase as an Item

🎯 Get the Best Micro Drone Experience

notes.title: Airport remake in Christmas update 2.6.7
notes.content:
Dear players,

This festive season, we want to express our gratitude for your support and passion for our game. As a special gift, we’ve prepared some exciting updates and events that you’re going to love! 🎄✨

[h3]Airport Remake: A Brand-New Look and Experience![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1838190/FPV_SkyDive__Airport/

[i]Game mode available on the main menu[/i]

Thank you for being part of our amazing community. From all of us, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! Let’s make this season unforgettable—together. 🎅🎁

ORQA Game Dev team

notes.title: Abandoned Factory Remastered
notes.content:
Greetings Pilots!

In the rest of this article, we bring you the key highlights from the new update along with a full list of changes.

[h2]Abandoned Factory Remastered[/h2]

We are proud to announce that, after 3 years, our most popular map is getting a fresh, yet familiar, new look. We've dedicated time to an extensive overhaul that will elevate your flight experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/d18d88acad16fc9b4e70bb89f2dc73bac5e3aa4d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/b350e83ae4861c9fdb9d1be9a6a126bfb5fcfcc9.png[/img]
Key highlights include:
[list][*] New underground sewer tunnels, specially designed for whoop drones, offering tight, technical spaces for precision flying.
[*] Expanded scenery with more greenery and variety in the surroundings for a richer, more immersive environment.
[*] Rework of the main building and its immediate surroundings to enhance detail and flow.
[*] New props added to enhance the map's backdrop and create a more dynamic flying space.
[/list] - and don’t worry, the map remains completely free! No need to break the bank for this adventure!

[h2]Physics Improvements & Auto-arm option[/h2]

Over the past few months, we've focused most of our efforts on developing and upgrading our in-house physics engine. In this update, we're rolling out tweaks to the whoop physics, which reflect the progress we've made in enhancing the overall flight realism.

Since we want to keep you updated on our ongoing physics improvements, we’re preparing a detailed article about our physics engine and future plans, set to release in the coming weeks. Stay tuned for more updates on what's next!

In addition to core physics changes, we’re improving the [b]user experience with the introduction of a new Auto-Arm mode[/b], aimed at making FPV flying more accessible to newcomers. In Auto-Arm mode, [b]your drone arms automatically when the throttle is set to 0%[/b], eliminating the need to press a physical button. For those who prefer manual control, this option can be switched off in the drone settings, returning the arming and disarming function to your calibrated button. All drones are now disarmed by default upon takeoff, adding a layer of safety.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/3ad6fb1a4e15cf68d0394224d83d9cd212776d72.png[/img]

[h2]More Challenges[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/b1dd6df964b69948266d154f7108f976966c025d.png[/img]

Our ongoing commitment to enhancing the arcade aspect of the simulator has led to the addition of [b]EIGHT new challenges![/b] These challenges will help you sharpen your skills while earning flight points to unlock pilot ranks.

The new challenges include:
[list]
[*] Three challenges on the Winter Wonderland map
[*] Three challenges on the Abandoned Factory map
[*] Two challenges on the Construction Site map
[/list][i]All of the challenges listed are available for regular drone type for free![/i]

[h3]Other update notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Map boundaries fix
[*] "Default" drone now is called "Racer"
[*] PID tweaks (should get realistic flying feeling on all drone models)
[*] "Video" settings renamed to "Graphics"
[*] Restart screen in fly mode is now black instead of game background
[*] When loading time is too long player will see that information
[*] If you are experiencing network problem and simulator cannot be connected to the server you will be automatically enter into the simulator in offline mode
[*] No internet connection text is visible in main menu ads position when offline mode is on
[*] Disarmed notification now blinks until drone is armed
[*] Instruction how to arm the drone are now visible on centre of the screen
[/list]

Our Discord community is the perfect place to meet like-minded individuals, exchange tips and tricks, and build lasting friendships. Don't miss out on the chance to be a part of our growing FPV.SkyDive family. Join us on Discord today and be part of the excitement!

notes.title: Introducing Drone Market
notes.content:
We're enhancing your gameplay experience with the introduction of the Drone Market and Selector in our latest update. 

From the start screen of the simulator, you'll now find animated drones, detailed view and a fluid overview of our entire drone lineup. The unified interface allows you to select and collect drones seamlessly, with any paid acquisitions facilitated intuitively through the Steam overlay so make sure that you have enabled it.

More information on Market elements:

[h2]Drone Market in action[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/a91a031b5c37a97836635181a48ee7a5a8772b95.gif[/img]
[i]Please note that drone prices, as depicted in the example above, may vary depending on promotions and the timing of the news creation.[/i]

[h2]Attributes and Performance[/h2]

Under the selected drone, attributes are displayed on a scale from 0-10, along with the drone's overall value. For casual pilots and gamers, we highlight key attributes such as [b]acceleration, stability, and agility[/b], which are crucial in distinguishing drones as either freestyle or racing types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/dc9a5dab1136fff9cd2de8935c22ef6f8028af1c.png[/img]
[i]Regular drone attributes[/i]

Experienced pilots can access additional details and parameters by pressing the "i" (info) button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/c3471cf6a17a9baaa1599d9328c31d50ceeb6cbd.png[/img]
[i]Regular drone detailed specification[/i]

[h2]Division of Micro and Regular FPV Drones[/h2]

To help users better understand each drone's classification and intended use, we've implemented a label below the drone's name indicating its group and purpose.

For example, the Whoop drone is labeled as "Micro Racing," classifying it as a racing drone in the micro division. Similarly, the Pure Racer is labeled as "Regular Racing," identifying it as a racing drone in the regular division.

In addition, attribute colors in the drone market will indicate their division affiliation. Regular drones will have attributes displayed in red, while micro drones will have attributes displayed in blue!

[h3]Attribute Scales[/h3]

For both divisions of drones, we have specific scales tailored to each division. This is done to ensure that all drones have a unified scale. Otherwise, micro drones would have lower attribute values compared to regular drones. This approach guarantees the credibility of parameters depending on the drone type, as the choice of drone type determines the playable content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392056/bb77df0d51d40284b3616699d76407800185e219.png[/img]
[i]Whoop drone attributes - Micro Drone (blue)[/i]

[b]The selection of a drone and its division and purpose determine the content available for that specific drone. For instance, a racing drone can participate in racing, freestyle, challenges, and multiplayer modes, whereas a freestyle drone offers the same options except for racing.[/b]

[*] Minor change in Pure Racer visual model
[*] Reduction of prop wash intensity on Cinewhoop and Whoop drones which caused strong shakiness between 30-40% of throttle
[/list]

notes.title: Exciting Summer, More Free Content & Better Value for Money
notes.content:
Hello, Pilots!

FPV SkyDive stands out as the premier free FPV simulator, boasting a user base of almost one million passionate drone enthusiasts. Our commitment has always been to enhance the simulator experience and provide exceptional value for money. Every dollar earned goes directly into improving FPV SkyDive, ensuring that users receive top-notch content and features!

[h2]New Content and Features Arriving This Summer[/h2]

[b]Revolutionary Creator Tool[/b]

This summer, we are excited to introduce a powerful new tool that will make track creation easier than ever before. While we can't reveal the exact name just yet, this tool promises to transform how users build their custom tracks, offering unparalleled flexibility and creativity.

But that's just the beginning. This tool will receive a series of updates, each adding even more fantastic features.

[b]Free Track Packs[/b]

In addition to the creator tool we are rolling out a series of free track packs specifically designed for regular drones. These packs will enhance your flying experience, providing more variety and challenges without any extra cost.

[h2]Enhanced User Experience and Game Division[/h2]

[b]Separation into Large and Small Drones[/b]

To further refine the user experience, FPV SkyDive will soon be divided into two distinct categories: large drones and small drones. This division will make the simulator more intuitive and user-friendly, catering to the unique characteristics and controls of different drone sizes.

[b]Updates to FPV SkyDive - NewBee x IRC Drone DLC[/b]

Alongside these changes, the FPV SkyDive - NewBee x IRC Drone DLC will undergo several upgrades. While there will be improvements and additions to this DLC, we assure you that there will be no increase in price. Our goal is to enhance the content without adding any financial burden on our users.

[h2]More Maps and DLC Packs[/h2]

[b]Consolidation of Maps and DLCs[/b]

Previously, each new map was released as a separate DLC. Moving forward, we are changing this practice. All maps you have purchased will remain in your ownership, but some existing DLCs will be rebranded to include multiple maps. This change means more content for a similar price, providing even greater value for our users.

[h2]Free Trials and Initial Discounts[/h2]

[b]Try Before You Buy[/b]

One of the significant changes coming this summer is the ability to try most of the content for free with limited-time access. Additionally, we will offer larger initial discounts during these trial periods, making it easier for users to explore new features and content before committing to a purchase.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

This summer promises to be an exciting time for FPV SkyDive users. With new tools, free track packs, enhanced user experience, and more value-packed content, we are dedicated to delivering the best possible FPV simulator experience. Whether you enjoy the game for free or own expansions, we aim to provide endless fun and adventure throughout the season.

Stay tuned for these updates and more as we continue to improve and expand FPV SkyDive. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: Introducing Flight School & Update 2.2
notes.content:
Today marks an exciting milestone in FPV.SkyDive as we proudly unveil [b]Flight School[/b] - the latest addition to Orqa’s leading free-to-play simulator!

The world of FPV has a noticeably high entry barrier, especially when it comes to more advanced concepts and flying techniques. So far, our free-to-play simulator has offered pilots to practice and improve their skills in an immersive & crash-free environment that directly translates to the real world flying experience. However, in the entire FPV community there have been very few structured, focused and curriculum-driven programmes aimed at introducing FPV concepts & learning more advanced techniques...until now.

The FPV.SkyDive Flight School offers interactive learning for pilots. With SkyDive's realistic simulation, it combines theory and practice in a structured curriculum. It's the ultimate FPV learning platform, providing visualized theory and interactive exercises.

The entire curriculum is structured and divided into units, the first of which releases today. The units themselves are divided into lessons and chapters which provide a theoretical and practical part, and sometimes examples.

In the first unit of more to come, pilots will be introduced to FPV concepts and learn the basics of flying. notes.content:
[h2]IMPROVED CALIBRATION SYSTEM[/h2]
After carefully considering community feedback and resolving the issue, we are pleased to announce that the initial calibration settings from version 2.0 are now available once again. To start calibration process of your joystick, simply navigate to the [b]settings[/b]->[b]controls[/b] menu.

Developers and testers thoroughly tested the new joystick calibration system across a wide range of controllers, including FPV transmitters and gamepads, and found no issues. With careful adherence to the calibration process, all known controllers should work seamlessly with the updated calibration system. We managed to simplify the calibration process from eight to just one step!

Active controller can be selected again in the main menu, located in the top right corner, in the event that multiple devices are connected.

[i]Calibration procedure notice is available at the bottom of this release note.[/i]

Next, select the Throttle stick mode for your controller, which can be either Manual or Auto, with a description available when you hover over each option. The Manual setting keeps the throttle stick in the position it is left in, while the Auto setting is similar to a gamepad, where both sticks return to the central position. After that you can assign sticks and buttons for every function.
